pairs.registryProposal: The golden path routes conflict POLICY to sync-replication and says a three-way diff against the ancestor is how a conflict becomes legible; this repo keeps the ancestor only as a hash (baseHash), which is the common case for hash-based sync. diff-honesty/pair-and-baseline could name what a two-way conflict view owes when the ancestor content is unrecoverable (declare it two-way, drop the -/+ direction glyphs for symmetric role marks).
